clue.text: Room for a medic in expensive French lodging

indicators.note: the French word is lodging, or housing, the doctor inside it

parts.note: cher is French for dear or expensive
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's qualification

explanation.surface: A doctor is looking for a room in some pricey lodgings in France.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lodging' is the container signal, the French word housing the doctor; 'in' is just a link word here.
explanation.definitionFit: A chamber is a formal or old word for a room, especially a bedroom.

clue.text: Body chap found in transporter

indicators.note: the man is found inside the vehicle

parts.note: a car transports people
Dave is a typical man's name, a chap

explanation.surface: A man's corpse is discovered inside a vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: A cadaver is a corpse, a dead body.

clue.text: Saw a large number grow old

parts.note: D is 500 in Roman numerals
to age is to grow old

explanation.surface: Someone notices many people getting older.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Saw' looks like the past of see; it is the noun meaning a proverb.
explanation.definitionFit: A saw is an old saying or proverb, as is an adage.

clue.text: Drink, despite hearing disapproving jeers

indicators.note: hearing tells us the jeers are listened to rather than spelt

parts.note: boos are jeers of disapproval

explanation.surface: Someone keeps drinking even while the crowd jeers.
explanation.walkthrough: BOOS sounds like the answer; 'despite' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Booze is informal for alcoholic drink.

clue.text: Genuine acceptance of fellow American? Anything but!

indicators.note: the word for genuine accepts, or takes in, the other letters

parts.note: genuine means real
US abbreviates American, as in United States

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a fellow American is truly welcomed, and the answer is no.
explanation.walkthrough: REAL accepts F and US; 'Anything but' then defines by contrast: anything but genuine acceptance.
explanation.definitionFit: A refusal is the opposite of agreeing, so it is anything but acceptance.

clue.text: Fighting-fit group, and sturdily built

parts.note: someone fighting-fit is healthy, or well
a set is a group of things or people

explanation.surface: A team of fit, strapping athletes is described.
explanation.definitionFit: A well-set person has a solid, strongly made frame.

clue.text: Intercepted when new road was opened

definitions.text: Intercepted when new road was opened

parts.words: Intercepted when new road was opened
parts.note: the route was put down, or laid, when it opened, a whimsical second reading of the verb

explanation.surface: Travellers were stopped on a freshly opened highway.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the answer as WAY LAID: a new road (way) is laid when built.
explanation.definitionFit: To waylay someone is to stop and accost them on their way.

clue.text: It may be discounted by traders

definitions.text: It may be discounted by traders

parts.words: It may be discounted by traders
parts.note: shops cut the official published cost when they offer a reduction

explanation.surface: Merchants offer reductions on something.
explanation.definitionFit: The manufacturer's recommended selling figure is what retailers knock money off.

clue.text: Replacement rugs are to be distributed

indicators.note: being distributed spreads the letters out into a new order

explanation.surface: New carpets are to be handed out as stand-ins.
explanation.definitionFit: A surrogate is a substitute standing in for someone or something.

clue.text: Consequently middlemen are in imminent danger

indicators.note: the letter is said to be in the word for danger

parts.note: a threat is a looming danger
read as middle of men, its central letter E

explanation.surface: Brokers face looming peril.
explanation.walkthrough: 'middlemen' looks like brokers; it means the middle of 'men', the letter E.
explanation.definitionFit: Thereat is an old word meaning because of that, or as a result.

clue.text: Six-footer makes monstrous woman dash off

parts.note: a dragon is slang for a fierce, formidable woman
to fly is to hurry away

explanation.surface: A tall person scares off a fearsome woman, who runs away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Six-footer' suggests a tall person; it is an insect, which has six legs.
explanation.definitionFit: Insects have six legs, so any insect, this darting one included, is jokingly a six-footer.

clue.text: Minister to offer biblical version within diocese

indicators.note: the version is placed within the word for a bishop's area

parts.note: a see is the area a bishop governs
RV is the Revised Version of the Bible

explanation.surface: A clergyman is asked to provide a new Bible translation across his diocese.
explanation.walkthrough: A see is a bishop's diocese. 'offer' is a link word that also hints at the answer's sense of providing.
explanation.definitionFit: To minister to people is to attend to their needs, to wait on them.

clue.text: They look at half-a-dozen vessels

parts.note: six is VI in Roman numerals
ewers are large water jugs

explanation.surface: Someone is examining six jugs.
explanation.definitionFit: Viewers are people who watch or look at something, such as a television audience.

clue.text: Authorise a past president to travel

parts.note: P abbreviates past, as in grammar for the past tense
to rove is to wander or travel about

explanation.surface: A former head of state is given clearance to go on a trip.
explanation.definitionFit: To approve something is to sanction it officially.

clue.text: Pop-music idols appear totally dependable

parts.note: rock is a style of popular music

indicators.note: to pop is to burst, so the word idols is broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: Stars of the pop charts are shown to be reliable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pop-music' looks like one term; 'Pop' is the anagram signal working on IDOLS, and 'music' alone gives ROCK. 'appear' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Something as solid as rock can be relied on completely.

clue.text: Pet needs a booster when rigid from shock

parts.note: a cat is a household pet
a tonic is something that boosts or restores

explanation.surface: A pet needs a pick-me-up when it freezes in fright.
explanation.definitionFit: Catatonic means in a stupor, frozen and unresponsive, as after trauma.

clue.text: Set apart by being in a state of stupor

definitions.meaning: placed at intervals with gaps between
dazed, as if drugged, out of touch

explanation.surface: Something is separated off by being dazed.
explanation.definitionFit: Things set apart are separated by gaps, and someone dazed or drugged is slangily disconnected.

clue.text: Doze during computer class? That's not on!

indicators.note: the snooze happens during the class, so it sits inside it

parts.note: IT, information technology, is a school subject about computers
a nap is a short doze

explanation.surface: Someone frowns on a pupil nodding off during an IT lesson.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not on' is the British phrase for unacceptable or inappropriate.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unsuitable or improper is described as not on, which matches inapt.

clue.text: Cavities cause some constant, raging toothache

indicators.note: only some of the letters of these words are used, a run across a word break

explanation.surface: A dentist warns that holes in teeth lead to non-stop pain.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer runs across 'constANT RAging'; 'toothache' only dresses the scene.
explanation.definitionFit: Antra is the plural of antrum, an anatomical cavity such as a sinus.

clue.text: Leave academic to support a veto

indicators.note: in a down answer a supporting word sits underneath, so it comes last

parts.note: a ban is a prohibition, a veto
a don is a university lecturer

explanation.surface: A lecturer quits to back a ban.
explanation.definitionFit: To abandon is to desert or leave behind.

clue.text: About time now to act for others

parts.note: re means about or concerning
the present is the current time

explanation.surface: It is suggested that the moment has come to work on others' behalf.
explanation.definitionFit: To represent people is to speak or act on their behalf.

clue.text: Transport gunners to exercise by river

parts.note: RA is the Royal Artillery, the gunners
PT is physical training, exercise
the Ure is a river in Yorkshire

explanation.surface: Artillerymen are moved to a riverside training spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Transport' looks like moving troops; it means ecstasy.
explanation.definitionFit: Transport can mean overwhelming emotion, and rapture is intense delight.

clue.text: Loyalist Irishman heads civil disturbance

indicators.note: in a down answer the man heads, or sits at the top of, the disturbance

parts.note: Pat is a stock Irish man's name
a riot is a violent public disturbance

explanation.surface: An Irish loyalist leads a street riot.
explanation.definitionFit: A patriot is someone devoted to their country.

clue.text: Jailer confines number in Eurasian country

indicators.note: the country confines, or holds inside it, the letter

parts.note: Turkey straddles Europe and Asia

explanation.surface: A prison guard locks up a prisoner in Turkey.
explanation.definitionFit: A turnkey is an old word for a jailer who holds the keys.

clue.text: Demolished new part of Belgian port

indicators.note: something demolished is knocked down, so these letters are wrecked and rebuilt

explanation.surface: A recently built section of a Belgian harbour has been knocked down.
explanation.definitionFit: Antwerp is a major port city on the Scheldt in Belgium.

clue.text: He takes alcohol left in delivery truck

indicators.note: the letter for left goes in the word for the truck

parts.note: a tipper is a lorry that tips out its load

explanation.surface: A man drinks booze he has stashed in his lorry.
explanation.definitionFit: A tippler is someone who drinks habitually, a boozer.

clue.text: Giant herbivore also found in Panama

indicators.note: the word for also is found inside the country abbreviation

parts.note: PA is the international code for Panama
and means also or in addition

explanation.surface: A huge plant-eater is spotted in Central America too.
explanation.walkthrough: 'found in Panama' suggests a hidden word, but the country's name does not contain the answer; the container signal works on its two-letter code instead.
explanation.definitionFit: The giant panda of China eats almost nothing but bamboo.

clue.text: Permission to cease attending

definitions.meaning: to go away, stop being present

explanation.surface: Someone is allowed to stop turning up.
explanation.definitionFit: A soldier gets authorised absence, and to quit a place is to depart.

clue.text: The hound is sound as a bell, love

parts.note: ding is the sound a bell makes
love is zero in tennis, a nought shaped like O

explanation.surface: A dog is declared perfectly healthy by an affectionate owner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sound as a bell' looks like the idiom for healthy; here it is the noise a bell makes.
explanation.definitionFit: The dingo is a wild Australian dog, so a kind of hound.

clue.text: Flag flown at marriage to mariner

parts.note: a union is a marriage
a jack, or jack tar, is a sailor

explanation.surface: A banner is hoisted at a wedding to a seaman.
explanation.walkthrough: The Union Jack is the national flag of the United Kingdom.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the name of the national flag of the United Kingdom.

clue.text: Niece made knot in man's accessory

indicators.note: the letters are made into something new, a rearranged form

parts.note: kt is the abbreviation for a knot, the nautical unit of speed

explanation.surface: A girl tied a knot in her uncle's neckwear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'made' signals an anagram of NIECE plus KT; 'in' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A tie worn round the collar is a traditional item of men's dress.

clue.text: Essay about classical drama

indicators.note: the attempt goes around, or about, the other word

parts.note: an essay is an attempt, a try
classical can mean ancient or old, aged

explanation.surface: A student writes a paper on ancient Greek plays.
explanation.walkthrough: 'classical drama' looks like the definition, but 'classical' supplies letters of its own, which 'about' places inside the essay.
explanation.definitionFit: A tragedy is a serious play ending in disaster, a form of theatre.
